response.sql: WITH per_order AS (SELECT orderslink, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_total_rebate, AVG(rebrate / NULLIF(feerate, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM fees WHERE rebrate > 0.0005 GROUP BY orderslink), scored AS (SELECT orderslink, avg_total_rebate, avg_ratio, avg_ratio / NULLIF(AVG(avg_ratio) OVER (), 0) AS relative_ratio FROM per_order) SELECT orderslink, avg_total_rebate, avg_ratio, relative_ratio FROM scored ORDER BY relative_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: A zero fee rate makes the rebate-to-fee ratio undefined, so that value is ignored. A zero overall mean likewise leaves the relative ratio undefined.
